Q: Avoid using OUTER APPLY in Query A:

  1. It seems you want a concrete solution to your problem... therefore this should have been a regular question, not a discussions question. All you can do now is delete this one and ask it again.

  2. You haven't provided a minimal reproducible example - there is no OUTER APPLY in the query shown and you don't show your desired results.

  3. It appears to actually be a SQL performance question and should therefore be asked as such - don't assume that because one construct (OUTER APPLY) is slow that you need to remove it. Instead carry out a proper performance investigation. MatBailie has explained what is required for this.

  4. Unfortunately this has to be said freshly to every SQL newbie - the structure of your query is not the deciding factor when it comes to performance. SQL is just a means to describe your desired resultset to the SQL engine, the engine then works out how to obtain this data. It certain doesn't obtain it in the method you have described it. Indexes and statistics play a big part in this.

Q: How to disable Recapcha in a hostinger hosted wesbite A:

I was having the same problem on my website https://2scan.net/ it's a QR code scanner online and I fixed it by following these steps

1- I add the Cloudflare IP address to the file .htaccess as a whitelist IP

https://www.cloudflare.com/ips/

<IfModule mod_authz_core.c>

# Whitelist Cloudflare IPv4 Ranges

Require ip 103.21.244.0/22

Require ip 103.22.200.0/22

Require ip 103.31.4.0/22

Require ip 104.16.0.0/13

Require ip 104.24.0.0/14

Require ip 108.162.192.0/18

Require ip 131.0.72.0/22

Require ip 141.101.64.0/18

Require ip 162.158.0.0/15

Require ip 172.64.0.0/13

Require ip 173.245.48.0/20

Require ip 188.114.96.0/20

Require ip 190.93.240.0/20

Require ip 197.234.240.0/22

Require ip 198.41.128.0/17



\# IPv6 Ranges

Require ip 2400:cb00::/32

Require ip 2606:4700::/32

Require ip 2803:f800::/32

Require ip 2405:b500::/32

Require ip 2405:8100::/32

Require ip 2a06:98c0::/29

Require ip 2c0f:f248::/32

</IfModule>

2- I add a cache header at the top of my PHP files

header("Cache-Control: public, max-age=16070400, s-maxage=15552000, stale-while-revalidate=3209600, immutable");

A cache valid for 6 months, you can change the time if you want
3- I go to Cloudflare dashboard => caching => configuration and set Browser Cache TTL to "Respect Existing Headers" so the header cache control we have set on the header will work

enter image description here
4- go to the cache rule and set Edge TTL to "Use cache-control header if present, bypass cache if not" and use also status ttl by add the rule range => from 403 => to 503 => no store
and do not set anything on Browser TTL

enter image description here

And at the end, purge everything from your cache

enter image description here
